description:
## 1.36.0-dev.110 (2026-08-10)

- Reddit: keep Reddit's native comment focus chain instead of automatically skipping three-dot controls.
- Reddit: bind the comment tint and O action to the exact same Compose comment target.
- Reddit: update the tint immediately after native keyboard navigation.
- Reddit: preserve the replacement comment target after Collapse or Expand changes its Compose node ID.
- Reddit: leave P preview behavior unchanged.
